capabilities: query JSON inline with @ path notation expanded as you type
filter arrays with logical and comparison operators
load and query external .json files relative to the note
display results as JSON, lists, tables or images
extras: README warns that large JSON files (thousands of entries) slow rendering and recommends querying external files instead of embedding them; includes a troubleshooting section with common error messages.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively query, filter or render JSON data embedded in notes or stored in external .json files.
summary: JSON query plugin that extracts and displays JSON data from code blocks or external files using an @ path syntax with filters and multiple output formats.
